subject: Consolidated QBR demo — prioritization & slot arbitration
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <arivera@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Melissa Khan <melissa.khan@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Consolidated QBR demo: run-of-show options and exec window

Hey Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We want to compress the QBR into a tighter, exec-friendly slot (we only have 20 minutes with our COO). Can you send a compact run-of-show and a few concrete slot options?

Constraints on our side:
- Exec availability: Nov 18 or Nov 19 only (they have travel on other days)
- Preferred windows: morning PT or late afternoon PT only
- Would like demo trimmed to ~30–45 minutes (technical walkthrough + 10–20m exec Q&A)

Can you also include a short ops checklist (recording, attendee list, link sharing) so I can route to our security/compliance team? We’re aiming to lock this by EOD Friday so procurement can pop the renewal on their calendar.

Appreciate it —
Alex Rivera
CTO, ClearLine Health
arivera@clearlinehealth.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <arivera@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Melissa Khan <melissa.khan@clearlinehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 17:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Consolidated QBR demo: run-of-show options and exec window

Alex — thanks for the constraints; we can make this work. Draft proposal below and attached is a concise run-of-show (QBR_run_of_show_v1.docx).

Two compact options (PT):
- Option A: Nov 18, 09:00–09:45 PT — 30m demo (product & ROI highlights) + 15m exec Q&A
- Option B: Nov 19, 16:30–17:15 PT — 30m demo + 15m exec Q&A (later slot to accommodate your team)

If you need the exec segment earlier in the block (e.g., to avoid travel conflicts), we can flip the order so exec Q&A is first (15m) followed by a focused 30m demo.

Next steps:
- Please confirm preferred option and whether exec should be first/last.
- Monica (CS) — can you validate ops readiness and confirm whether we need recording consent docs or a special SSO link?
- Jonas — I’ve looped you for any pre-demo technical blockers we should call out.

Attachments: QBR_run_of_show_v1.docx (draft run-of-show; one page, compact)

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <arivera@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Melissa Khan <melissa.khan@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated QBR demo: run-of-show options and exec window

Alex / team — quick ops note: Nov 18 morning is tight for our recording/ops team (we have a prep window that day). I can staff Nov 19 16:30 PT but if you really need Nov 18 we can do a later evening slot (Nov 18, 18:00 PT) if your execs can make it.

I attached a one-page ops checklist (ops-checklist.pdf) — it calls out:
- Required attendee list (exec + tech)
- Recording consent (we need explicit OK from your execs)
- Link & calendar ICS distribution plan
- Backup plan (phone bridge + recording fallback)

Small ask for the run: please confirm whether we can record. If yes, we’ll circulate redwood-demo-recording-consent.txt for signature before the meeting.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

1) Can we move the exec Q&A to start at 16:20 (so execs can join for the first 15 minutes, then step into their next commitment)?
